individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise
individuals.quote: **Wikimedia Enterprise** is a service of the Wikimedia Foundation available via enterprise.wikimedia.com.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation
individuals.quote: Given the nature of the service, primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation.

individuals.title: Commercial Partnerships
individuals.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise project is helmed by the **Commercial Partnerships** division

individuals.title: Advancement Department
individuals.quote: which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation

individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise LLC
individuals.quote: The LLC is subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees

individuals.quote: subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees

individuals.title: Vuurr

individuals.title: Super Natural Design
individuals.quote: **Super Natural Design** are the designers of the project website

individuals.title: Speed & Function
individuals.quote: Engineering support was provided in the first years by **Speed & Function**.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Deutschland
individuals.quote: the request will be reviewed in coordination with staff from *Wikimedia Deutschland*.

individuals.title: Snapshot API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Snapshot API allows users to retrieve entire Wikimedia projects as a database dump file.

individuals.title: On-demand API
individuals.quote: The Wikimedia Enterprise On-demand API allows users to retrieve single articles from any supported Wikimedia project at anytime.

individuals.title: Realtime API
individuals.quote: The Enterprise Realtime API allows users to stream updates in real-time from any supported Wikimedia project.

individuals.title: Movement Strategy recommendations
individuals.quote: In the Movement Strategy recommendations to *increase the sustainability of our movement* and *improve user experience* there are the recommendations to

individuals.title: Increase the sustainability of our movement
individuals.quote: under the heading of *Increase the sustainability of our movement* the Movement Strategy process asked the Wikimedia Foundation to explore

individuals.title: Improve user experience
individuals.quote: under the heading *Improve User Experience*, a further recommendation stated

individuals.title: Access for all
individuals.quote: in accordance with the project's principle of *access for all*

individuals.title: Non-exclusivity principle
individuals.quote: In accordance with the Wikimedia Enterprise operating principles regarding non-exclusivity

individuals.title: Content program goal
individuals.quote: **Content**: Make more of our movement's content available in consistent machine-readable formats, freely available for all researchers and re-users.

individuals.title: Resource-load program goal
individuals.quote: **Resource-load**: Reduce the need for high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers

individuals.title: Fundraising program goal
individuals.quote: **Fundraising**: Provide a clearer and more consistent way for the largest re-users to reinvest derived benefits back to the movement

individuals.title: Enterprise API revenue supports Wikimedia mission
individuals.quote: All Enterprise API revenue will unequivocally be used to support the Wikimedia mission

individuals.title: Frequency requirement for reusers
individuals.quote: **Frequency**: Regular current snapshots of Wikimedia projects

individuals.title: Reliability requirement for reusers
individuals.quote: **Reliability**: Dependable, accessible infrastructure

individuals.title: Quality requirement for reusers
individuals.quote: **Quality**: a “best last revision”

individuals.title: Very high barrier to entry for Wikimedia data
individuals.quote: There is a very high barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data, outside of the common use cases of reading or editing.

individuals.title: Exceptional access
individuals.quote: you may request free **exceptional access** to the higher rate of the Enterprise APIs.

individuals.title: Six exceptional access criteria
individuals.quote: with a response to the six criteria described below

individuals.title: Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy
individuals.quote: as described on the *Wikimedia Foundation Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy*.

individuals.title: 99% SLA for contracted accounts
individuals.quote: Contracted accounts receive 99% SLA and support response-time guarantees.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Enterprise launch in October 2021
individuals.quote: launched in October 2021 (Press release, OpenFutures article)
